heading_en: General Provisions on the Application of Credit Risk Mitigation Techniques to Securitization Exposures
summary_ja: 証券化エクスポージャーの信用リスク・アセットの額の算出で勘案できる担保の範囲と、保証・クレジット・デリバティブ・適格金融資産担保・適格資産担保について準用する規定及びその読替えを定める。
summary_en: Specifies which collateral may be recognized for securitization exposures under each risk-weight method, and which credit risk mitigation provisions apply mutatis mutandis, with their term replacements.
paragraphs: In calculating the credit risk-weighted assets of a securitization exposure held by an Ultimate Designated Parent Company, in addition to the credit risk mitigation effect of guarantees or credit derivatives provided for the securitization exposure, the credit risk mitigation effect of the collateral set out in the following items (including collateral provided by a securitization special purpose entity), according to the classification of cases set out in those items, may be taken into account: (i) where the internal ratings-based approach-compliant method is used to calculate the risk weight applied to the securitization exposure: the following collateral: (a) eligible financial collateral prescribed in Article 66; (b) eligible asset collateral that satisfies the operational requirements prescribed in Article 133, paragraph (5); (ii) where the external ratings-based approach-compliant method or the standardized approach-compliant method is used to calculate the risk weight applied to the securitization exposure: eligible financial collateral prescribed in Article 65 (eligible financial collateral prescribed in Article 66 where the comprehensive approach is used).

Chapter 3, Section 6 and Article 130, paragraphs (1), (4) and (5) apply mutatis mutandis where the credit risk mitigation effect of guarantees or credit derivatives is taken into account pursuant to the preceding paragraph. In this case, the term "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach" in that Section shall be read as "Ultimate Designated Parent Company"; the term "those for which an eligible credit rating agency has assigned a rating" in Article 98, item (ii) shall be read as "those for which an eligible credit rating agency has assigned a rating corresponding to credit risk category 3-3 or higher and, at the initial point at which credit risk mitigation techniques are taken into account, has assigned a rating corresponding to credit risk category 3-2 or higher"; the term "including affiliated companies, etc." shall be read as "including affiliated companies, etc. but excluding securitization special purpose entities"; the term "residual maturity of the exposure" in Article 107 shall be read as "residual maturity of the exposure (where a single credit risk mitigation technique is provided for multiple securitization exposures with different residual maturities, that of the securitization exposure with the longest residual maturity; the same applies in the following Article)"; the term "Notwithstanding the preceding Article, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach" in Article 130, paragraph (1) shall be read as "An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach", and the term "exposures to business corporations, etc." shall be read as "securitization exposures"; and the term "Article 101" in paragraphs (4) and (5) of that Article shall be read as "Articles 101 and 104".

Chapter 3, Section 6 applies mutatis mutandis where the credit risk mitigation effect of eligible financial collateral is taken into account pursuant to paragraph (1) (limited to the portions relating to item (i)(a) and item (ii) of that paragraph). In this case, the term "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach" in that Section shall be read as "Ultimate Designated Parent Company", and the term "residual maturity of the exposure" in Article 90, item (i) shall be read as "residual maturity of the exposure (where a single credit risk mitigation technique is provided for multiple securitization exposures with different residual maturities, that of the securitization exposure with the longest residual maturity; the same applies in Articles 107 and 108)".

Article 133, paragraph (3) (excluding the proviso) through paragraph (5) (excluding item (iv)) apply mutatis mutandis where the credit risk mitigation effect of eligible asset collateral is taken into account pursuant to paragraph (1) (limited to the portion relating to item (i)(b) of that paragraph). In this case, in those provisions, the term "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the foundation internal ratings-based approach" shall be read as "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach"; the term "Notwithstanding the preceding paragraph, exposures to business corporations, etc. (excluding subordinated debt)" shall be read as "securitization exposures"; the term "or where eligible financial collateral has been established" shall be read as "has been established"; the term "exposures to business corporations, etc." shall be read as "securitization exposures"; and the term "exposures to business corporations, etc. (excluding subordinated debt)" shall be read as "securitization exposures".
